title: Can You Hire a Boat for a Photo or Video Shoot in Madeira?
description: You can. A private boat gives you south coast cliffs as a backdrop, with drone footage, 360 video and camera photos included. Plan the light, then the trip.
heroAlt: Woman in a long dress at the bow of a boat below Cabo Girão at golden hour
keywords: can you hire a boat for a photoshoot in madeira
video shoot on a boat funchal

images.prompt: Golden hour on the south coast of Madeira, seen from a low angle on the water a short distance from the boat. A woman in a long, light red dress stands at the bow of a white 9 metre motor boat with grey cushioned seats and a dark canopy, seen from behind and slightly to the side, the dress moving in the wind, no face visible. A photographer crouches on deck with a camera, also seen from behind. Above them the huge cliff of Cabo Girão glows warm in low sunlight. Calm water, true colours, natural light.
images.alt: Woman in a long dress at the bow of a boat below Cabo Girão at golden hour

images.prompt: Detail on a boat deck: a professional camera with a lens hood, a lens cloth and a small dry bag on a grey cushioned seat, warm evening light, blurred sea and cliffs behind, no people.
images.alt: Camera, lens cloth and dry bag on a boat seat in warm evening light

images.prompt: Blue hour from the sea: the lights of Funchal coming on across the hillside, the sky deep blue with a last strip of orange, calm dark water in the foreground with a soft reflection of the city, no boats close up.
images.alt: Funchal hillside lights coming on at blue hour seen from the sea
